subject: general
question: Krishna River flows through ______ state of India.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e.__**, Karnataka.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The Krishna river originates in the Western Ghats near Mahabaleshwar in the state of Maharashtra.
 
• Krishna river flows through Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Krishna Basin extends nearly 8% of the total geographical area of the country.
 
• The river has a number of tributaries which include Tungabhadra as the principal tributary and others are Mallaprabha, Koyna, Bhima, Ghataprabha, Yerla, Warna, Dindi, Musi, and Dudhganga.
 
• Nagarjuna Sagar Dam on the Krishna river is the world’s tallest masonry dam (124 meters).
